budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants for 2/3/25 – 2/4/25 were signed and approved at a stated total.

budget_items.topic: Line item transfer for roof HVAC
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A line item transfer moved funds from vehicle maintenance to contracted services for HVAC work on the LMHS roof.
budget_items.quote: line item transfers - $9,200 from vehicle maintenance to contracted services to take care of hvac on roof

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The district requested funding from the finance committee for an unbudgeted cost of 911 upgrades at Turkey Hill.
budget_items.quote: requested funding for the $60,000 unbudgeted additional cost for the 911 upgrades at turkey hill.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The athletic user fee proposal raises high school and middle school fees and provides a sibling discount.
budget_items.quote: increase fee for high school up to $325 and $275 for middle school.

budget_items.topic: Reduced athletic fee and family cap
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The athletic fee proposal sets a reduced fee and a family cap.
budget_items.quote: reduced fee for high school to $50 and $40 for middle school with a family cap of $1500.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A proposal to increase facilities fees by a percentage was accepted.
budget_items.quote: facilities proposal to increase fees by 50%

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter said six activities she participates in would cost $450, more than any athletic fee increase.
budget_items.quote: that would cost $450 which is more than any of the athletic fees were raised.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter said reeds can cost $50 a semester.
budget_items.quote: you need reeds and that can cost $50 a semester.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public question raised a salary increase of $71,000 for an HR Specialist; the superintendent said the position was moved from another part of the budget.
budget_items.quote: i saw a salary increase of $71,000 for an hr specialist

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member said the town has invested more than $60 million through debt exclusions.
budget_items.quote: in excess of $60 million just in debt exclusions.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member said the Student Opportunity Act is set to increase statewide school funding by over $1.5 billion by 2027.
budget_items.quote: this law is set to increase school funding by over $1.5 billion by 2027

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member said costs since 2020 have risen with 18% inflation over four years.
budget_items.quote: we have experienced 18% inflation over that four year period.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter said the lack of overrides and a full tax levy creates a larger budgeted gap.
budget_items.quote: lack of overrides, a full 2 ½% tax creates an even larger budgeted gap.
